title: lib.rs: #![forbid(unsafe_code)] appears before //! crate doc
description: In jmap-server/src/lib.rs, #![forbid(unsafe_code)] is the very first line, before the //! crate-level documentation comments. Rustdoc renders fine, but the conventional Rust ordering is: crate doc (//!) first, then inner attributes (#![...]). This is a minor style issue but inconsistent with the rest of the crate family.
